SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.PENDING_RESTART: Mod changes will be applied after a restart.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.ORDER_PROBLEMS: For compatibility, {count} mods will be automatically reordered by the base game on relaunch.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.ORDER_PROBLEMS_ONE: For compatibility, 1 mod will be automatically reordered by the base game on relaunch.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.SHOW_ENABLED_TIP: Only enabled mods: the ones that load after a relaunch
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.SHOW_CHANGED_TIP: Only mods changed since launch: the ones listed in Changes
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.LIST_PROBLEMS_OFF: {count} enabled mods need a mod that is disabled.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.LIST_PROBLEMS_OFF_ONE: 1 enabled mod needs a mod that is disabled.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.LIST_PROBLEMS_MISSING: {count} enabled mods need a mod that isn't installed.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.LIST_PROBLEMS_MISSING_: 1 enabled mod needs a mod that isn't installed.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.MANAGERS_WARNING: Multiple mod managers are currently enabled, which may cause unexpected behavior.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.DISMISS_MANAGERS_TIP: Hides this warning. It comes back if one of the mod managers is disabled and then enabled again.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.RELAUNCH_CHECK_INTRO: These mods are enabled, but won't load:
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.RELAUNCH_CHECK_OK: Every enabled mod can load now.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.NO_CATEGORIES_HINT: No categories yet. Right-click a mod and choose "{item}" to make one.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.DELETE_CATEGORY_BODY: [gold]{name}[/gold] holds {count} mods. They will move to Uncategorized.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.DELETE_CATEGORY_BODY_O: [gold]{name}[/gold] holds 1 mod. It will move to Uncategorized.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TAGS_BULK_ADD: Add tags to all of them
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TAGS_BULK_HINT: Tags they all share; new ones go on every one, comma-separated
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.NOTES_BULK_ADD: Add notes to all of them
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.NOTES_BULK_HINT: The same notes for every one of them
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.NOTES_BULK_MIXED: Their notes differ: what you type here replaces them all
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TAG_GAMEPLAY_TIP: This mod affects gameplay. All players will need it enabled for multiplayer.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TAG_LIBRARY_TIP: This is a framework intended to be used by other mods; often has no effect when installed alone.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TAG_LOCAL_TIP: This mod is installed in the game's mods folder, not from the Steam Workshop.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TAG_NEW_TIP: This mod was installed after the game started. It loads after a relaunch.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TAG_COSMETIC_TIP: This mod adds visuals, such as character skins, battle animations, UI or textures.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.ALIAS_HINT: An alternative title for the mod
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.AUTHOR: Author
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.STATE_DUPLICATE: Disabled: another copy of this mod is loaded
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.SEARCH_CLICK_TIP: Click: search this term; Shift-click: add to search
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.HOLD_ALT: Hold Alt to see the full text
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.NO_CHANGES: Nothing has changed since the game started.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.CHANGES_OPEN_HINT: Click a mod to open it
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.NEW_MOD_BODY: New mods were detected. They load after a relaunch.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.DATA_TITLE: Spire Mod Manager couldn't read your data
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.DATA_RECOVERED: The file with your categories, profiles and notes couldn't be read, so the backup from {date} was loaded instead. The unreadable file is kept in the mod's data folder as {file}.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.DATA_FRESH: The file with your categories, profiles and notes couldn't be read, and there was no backup, so you're starting fresh. The unreadable file is kept in the mod's data folder as {file}.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.DATA_READ_ONLY: The file with your categories, profiles and notes couldn't be read or moved aside, so changes this session won't be saved. If another program has it open, close that program and relaunch. It's {file}, in the mod's data folder.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.LAUNCH_FAILED_TITLE: The last launch stopped before the main menu
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.MOVE_HINT: Click to place · right-click or Esc to cancel
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.RELAUNCH_NOTE: Relaunch to apply your mod changes
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.NEEDS_UPDATE: Spire Mod Manager needs an update for this game version.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.UNSAVED_CLICK: Click to list them in the side panel
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.DELETE_PROFILE_BODY: Delete the profile [gold]{name}[/gold]? Your mods stay installed; only this saved selection goes.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.SHARE_BODY: {name} as a CSV mod list. Copy the text, or save it as a file to send. Your aliases and notes aren't included.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.IMPORT_BODY: Paste a CSV mod list, or load a CSV file. Lists from Spire Mod Manager and Better Mod Menu both work. Nothing changes until you create the profile.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.IMPORT_EMPTY: Paste a mod list or load a CSV file first.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.IMPORT_NO_ID: This list has no Mod Id column. Its first line must name the columns, including Mod Id and Enabled.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.IMPORT_NO_ENABLED: This list has no Enabled column. Its first line must name the columns, including Mod Id and Enabled.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.IMPORT_BAD_ENABLED: Enabled for {mod} should be TRUE or FALSE, not "{value}".
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.IMPORT_NO_MODS: This list has no mods in it.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.IMPORT_SAME: {count} mods are already set that way
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.IMPORT_SAME_ONE: 1 mod is already set that way
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.IMPORT_UNLISTED: {count} installed mods aren't in the list and stay as they are
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.IMPORT_UNLISTED_ONE: 1 installed mod isn't in the list and stays as it is
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.IMPORT_MISSING: Not installed ({count}). The profile remembers them: once they're installed, switching to it enables or disables them as listed:
